name: Takahara Yuuya
source:
Keiou University 4th year, Business Major.

"That may be true, but I chose to do it because I have to."

Another intern at Edo Publishing, but is in the marketing department. A polite and well-mannered man who is good at his work, but seems to be hiding many secrets. As he never had a girlfriend, the seniors in the company often try to pair him up with Asami or tease him about other things. Due to having poor eyesight, he wears glasses on a daily basis.

[From [url=https://precatio.wordpress.com/characters/]official site[/url]]
